how: We read the website of every Boston wedding photographer listed on Lazo (187 listings, 137 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: family and portrait studios, a photographer who has moved to Florida, a photo booth company, officiants, and DJ or video teams listed as photographers. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Have you shot a dark Boston ballroom or a winter church, and can I see a full gallery from a day like mine, not just highlights?
If my date is in foliage season, how many weddings are you booking that month, and who covers me if you are sick?
Is a second shooter included, what is the delivery timeline, and is an engagement session part of the package?

picks.name: Spagnolo Wedding Photography
picks.blurb: Aaron and Nanore are a Boston-based team who have photographed weddings, micro-weddings and elopements across Massachusetts since 2011. Their approach is attentive and relaxed, gentle guidance mixed with candid moments, whether they shoot together or on their own.

picks.name: Kelly Stevens Photography
picks.blurb: Kelly Stevens photographs weddings throughout Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Maine and Rhode Island from a home near the sea, and asks couples to be present in the day and trust her with the pictures. Her blog covers practical things like whether a professional album is worth it and mansion venues across New England.

picks.name: Sam Liang Photography
picks.blurb: Sam Liang shoots documentary weddings out of Cambridge, drawn to the glances and inside jokes couples share when they think nobody is watching. He is part of the LGBTQ+ community himself, and promises honest pricing and a clear process for Boston and New England weddings.

picks.name: Angelina Rose Photography
picks.blurb: Angelina Rose is a documentary wedding photographer based in Boston and Sharon who says outright that she is not a trendy photographer. Her best work comes from couples who lean into who they are and trust her to record the heartwarming, hilarious and messy moments as they happen.

picks.name: CityLux
picks.blurb: CityLux is a small team of Boston wedding photographers with one shared editing style, named Best of Boston by Boston Magazine, with collections starting at $7,000 and a limited number of weddings each year. Now booking 2027, and growing into Southwest Florida as well.

picks.name: Lovely Valentine Photography + Film
picks.blurb: Emilie Pickering of Lovely Valentine trained in architecture before turning to editorial wedding photography, bright and colorful on film and digital, with filmmaking from the same Somerville studio. Full-day photography begins at $8,000, for Boston, Newport and destinations.

picks.name: Jemima Richards Photography
picks.blurb: Jemima Richards describes her work as photography for bougie weirdos who believe in romance without rules, shot on digital, film and Super 8 across New England and New York. An Australian based in Worcester, she looks for the in-between moments rather than Pinterest replicas.

picks.name: Teresa Johnson Photography
picks.blurb: After a decade of weddings and a few Olympic Trials before that, Teresa Johnson says the camera is the easy part and spends her energy on timelines, nervous bridal parties and missing groomsmen. Documentary and colorful, working Boston, Massachusetts, Connecticut and Rhode Island.

picks.name: Maureen Russell Photography
picks.blurb: Maureen Russell became a photographer in 2013 after a honeymoon spent taking thousands of pictures, and now shoots Massachusetts weddings from Kingston alongside senior and family sessions. Her site has a full pricing and experience page rather than a quote form.

picks.name: Mark R. Ducharme Photography
picks.blurb: Mark Ducharme has photographed New England weddings since 2007 and works Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Vermont and Maine from Lowell. The investment page includes an engagement session with every wedding except elopements, and he says he is reachable around the clock for questions.

picks.name: Arlene D Marston Photography
picks.blurb: Arlene Marston started photographing weddings over ten years ago and covers Salem, Marblehead, Beverly, Cape Ann and Boston. She frames wedding pictures as family history to be passed down, and her site prints package pricing instead of hiding it.

picks.name: Madison Van Wylen | Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Madison Van Wylen documents Newport weddings as they unfold, without asking couples to perform, offering reassurance when needed and light guidance when helpful. Based in Newport, available across New England and willing to travel worldwide.
